title: Fluffy Japanese Soufflé Jiggly Pancakes
hookLine: Sky-high cloud pancakes steamed gently in a covered skillet with whipped maple butter.

items.name: Granulated sugar + 1/4 tsp cream of tartar

steps.title: Preheat Waffle Iron & Prep Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your waffle iron or griddle to medium-high heat and brush lightly with butter or neutral oil. Measure out {eggs_sp} and {flour_sp} in a mixing bowl so the batter or dough is ready as soon as the iron is hot.

steps.title: Fold Airy Egg Whites Gently
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk egg yolks with {flour_sp}. Whip whites from {eggs_sp} with {sugar_sp} to stiff glossy peaks and fold gently. Keep {eggs_sp}, {flour_sp}, and {sugar_sp} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Cook Covered Low Heat 5m/Side
steps.instructionTemplate: Mound batter tall onto a lightly oiled nonstick pan on lowest heat, add 1 tbsp water to pan edge, cover, and steam 5 mins per side.
steps.creatorSecret: Adding 1 tbsp water before covering generates gentle steam for maximum height.

steps.title: Cool 1 Minute on Rack & Plate
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Fluffy Japanese Soufflé Jiggly Pancakes onto a wire rack for 60 seconds so steam escapes and the outside stays crisp. Top with {sugar_sp} and serve immediately into 2 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 20 mins.
